newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Aircraft Ind to service BA planes.
newsitem.headline: Israel Aircraft Ind to service BA planes.

text.p: Israel Aircraft Industries will carry out maintenance work on British Airways Plc planes on a one-year trial basis at its Bedek service facility at Tel Aviv's Ben-Gurion airport, IAI said on Sunday.
Bedek deputy managing director David Artzi said in a statement the state-owned company would work on a "limited number" of BA planes in the first year, after which both sides would review the deal.
A BA Boeing 757 is already undergoing maintenance work, expected to last two weeks, at Bedek, IAI said.
British Airways operates 15 flights a week between Ben-Gurion and London's Heathrow and Gatwick airports.
